examples.scenario: Phishing attack via Instagram direct message containing a shortened URL leading to a fake Instagram login page designed to steal user credentials.

social_media_message_raw.message_text: Hi! We noticed suspicious activity on your account. Please verify your login immediately to avoid suspension: https://bit.ly/3LfakeUrl

url_obfuscation_techniques: Use of URL shortener bit.ly to hide final malicious URL
Domain name mimics legitimate brand with hyphen and extra words (instagram-secure-login.com)
Use of JWT-like session token parameter to appear legitimate

examples.detection_method: Detection via URL reputation feeds and real-time analysis of incoming social media messages; browser anti-phishing extensions flagging suspicious domain patterns; monitoring DNS query logs for newly registered domains mimicking brands; web proxy logs identifying POST requests to non-official Instagram domains with typical credential field names.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1586.003 - Compromise Infrastructure: Social Media Accounts
T1071.001 - Application Layer Protocol: Web Protocols
